items.exampleEn: Scientists made a speculative estimate of the age of the stones.
items.exampleZh: 科學家對這些石頭的年代做了推測性的估計。

items.exampleEn: Years of poor service have created deep cynicism among customers.
items.exampleZh: 多年來的差勁服務讓顧客普遍抱持很深的不信任。

items.exampleEn: She asked several pertinent questions during the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 她在會議中問了好幾個切中要點的問題。

items.exampleEn: The hero of the novel is a realist surrounded by friends who only dream.
items.exampleZh: 這本小說的主角是個務實的人，身邊的朋友卻只會做夢。

items.exampleEn: Critics wrote favorably about her first novel.
items.exampleZh: 評論家對她的第一本小說給予好評。

items.exampleEn: Our estimation of the costs was much too low.
items.exampleZh: 我們對成本的估計太低了。

items.exampleEn: A smile from the teacher was all the reassurance he needed.
items.exampleZh: 老師的一個微笑，就足以讓他安心。

items.exampleEn: The museum shows ingenious machines from the past.
items.exampleZh: 博物館展示了過去巧妙精良的機器。

items.sentenceEn: Please keep your questions pertinent to today's topic.
items.sentenceZh: 請讓你的提問與今天的主題相關。

items.audioEn: The customers reacted favorably to the new menu, so the restaurant will keep it.
items.audioZh: 顧客對新菜單的反應很好，所以餐廳會保留它。
items.questionZh: 餐廳為什麼要保留新菜單？

items.sentenceEn: The article is speculative; it offers no hard evidence.
items.sentenceZh: 這篇文章只是推測，沒有提出確切的證據。

items.sentenceEn: In my estimation, the job will take about three weeks.
items.sentenceZh: 依我的判斷，這份工作大約需要三個星期。

items.stemEn: Her ____ design turned an old bottle into a lamp.
items.stemZh: 她巧妙的設計把一個舊瓶子變成了一盞燈。

items.stemEn: She looked to her parents for ____ before the big exam.
items.stemZh: 大考前，她向父母尋求安慰。

items.passageEn: Two engineering students designed an ingenious device that turns rain into drinking water, and they entered a national competition. Building it took an immense amount of testing. At first, they met with some cynicism. One judge, who called himself a realist, asked whether poor villages could afford it. The students had expected such questions and gave pertinent answers about cost and repairs. Their figures were still speculative, but the judges reacted favorably and gave them second prize. For the students, the result was a reassurance that their years of work had not been wasted.
items.passageZh: 兩名工程系學生設計了一個能把雨水變成飲用水的巧妙裝置，並報名參加全國比賽。製作過程經過了大量的測試。一開始，他們遇到一些冷嘲熱諷的質疑。一位自稱現實主義者的評審問，貧窮的村莊是否負擔得起。學生們早就料到會有這類問題，針對成本和維修給出了切中要點的回答。他們的數字仍屬推估，但評審反應正面，頒給他們第二名。對學生來說，這個結果讓他們確信，多年的努力沒有白費。

questions.questionZh: 一位評審問了什麼問題？
options: 這台機器能使用多少年

items.promptZh: 這間新餐廳和其他餐廳相比毫不遜色。
referenceEn: This new restaurant compares favorably with the others.
The new restaurant compares favorably to other restaurants.
rubricZh: compare favorably with／to 表示「相比之下毫不遜色」（例如 compares favorably with the others 等）
「其他餐廳」可寫，例如 the others、other restaurants 等

items.promptZh: 談到預算，我們的經理是個非常務實的人。
referenceEn: When it comes to budgets, our manager is very much a realist.
Our manager is a true realist when it comes to the budget.
rubricZh: 「務實的人」用 realist（例如 very much a realist、a true realist 等）
「談到預算」可寫，例如 when it comes to budgets、when it comes to the budget 等，放句首或句尾皆可

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似語意重複：made a speculative guess——guess 本身就是推測，speculative 多餘；可改 a speculative estimate 或 Their theory about the age of the stones is speculative。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "a speculative estimate of the age of the stones"，避免 speculative guess 語意重複

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: realist、ingenious 換成名詞 estimation（本課）、irony（u06-l02），放得進 looked to her parents for ____ 但語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 speculative 放進句中仍說得通（Her speculative design turned an old bottle into a lamp）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: speculative 換成 knowledgeable（u06-l01；設計不會「知識淵博」，語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：compare favorably with／to 表示「相比之下毫不遜色」（例如 compares favorably with the others 等）／「其他餐廳」可寫，例如 the others、other restaurants 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：realist 表示「務實的人、現實主義者」（例如 I am a realist、very much a realist 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（realist）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u06-l05-q17；目標字沿用 realist
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「談到預算，我們的經理是個非常務實的人。」、hintWords ["realist"]、referenceEn ["When it comes to budgets, our manager is very much a realist.","Our manager is a true realist when it comes to the budget."]、rubricZh ["「務實的人」用 realist（例如 very much a realist、a true realist 等）","「談到預算」可寫，例如 when it comes to budgets、when it comes to the budget 等，放句首或句尾皆可"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 realist 造一個句子，說說你在某件事上是不是一個務實的人。」、referenceEn ["I am a realist, so I always plan for delays when I travel.","When it comes to money, I am very much a realist."]）
